name: Ortur Aufero AL1
tagline: Compact portable Ortur : desk-friendly engraver for small gifts
tldr: The Aufero AL1 is Ortur's compact diode line for small work areas and portable setups. Lower power than LM3 or H10, but easier to fit on a crowded desk. Best for light engraving : not a cutting workhorse.
mainObjective: Small-footprint Ortur for gift engraving & learning on a budget

engraveExample.description: Filled photo or logo on birch plywood

editorialDepth.advantages: Ortur Aufero AL1 5W suits makers who sell marks, photos, and gifts more than daily panel cutting. Reasonable open-frame entry price.
editorialDepth.limitations: Skip if you already quote 3 mm+ cutting in production. Not for cast acrylic or bare metal without spray.
